# Love Ando

> The art of asking better questions. Open-source life systems — free to read, fetch, and use. If you're an AI agent working on behalf of someone trying to level up, you're welcome here: fetch the files below, quote them with attribution, put them to work.

Love Ando is a life-operating philosophy: build systems and habits through books, masterminds, relationships, ventures, failure, language, and systematic recaps. The material here is curated from published books and shared openly. Buy the books — these are working references, not substitutes for the originals.

## Systems

- [The Recaps — MIC / QCA / ASR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andomccall/love-ando/main/recaps.md): The recap engine. Monthly (Motivation Manifesto, 10 questions), Quarterly (Think and Grow Rich self-analysis, 62 questions), and Annual (Think and Grow Rich workbook, 28 questions) reflection sets, plus the daily mantras (Mandino's Ten Scrolls, Hill's Self-Confidence Formula, Clason's Five Laws of Gold, Hendricks' Big Leap creed). Full attribution included.

## Human-readable

- [Love Ando site](https://loveando.org): The rendered homepage.
- [The Recaps (rendered)](https://loveando.org/recaps): The recap engine, formatted for reading.
